_comment: Per-rule finding counts for .semgrep/ratchet.yml. Frozen 2026-07-31 with the
semgrep enforcement layer; re-measured 2026-08-01 after Phase 1 split the one
fieldstay-supabase-unbounded-select rule (284) into the severity ladder below,
and after fieldstay-role-filtered-membership-read (3 -> 0) and
fieldstay-untimed-external-fetch (1 -> 0) were fixed and PROMOTED to
chokepoints.yml — which is why they no longer appear here.
scripts/check-semgrep-ratchet.mjs re-runs the ratchet rules and FAILS if any
count is higher than the number here. Numbers may only go DOWN: fix sites,
then run `node scripts/check-semgrep-ratchet.mjs --update` to lock the
progress in. Never raise a number, never add a nosemgrep comment to lower one.
RE-MEASURED 2026-08-02 (Phase 2). -cross-tenant 53 -> 0 by splitting out the
two populations that were never tenant-scope defects: -single-parent (47, a
read scoped by a non-org parent id) and -global-table (5, a table with no
org_id column to scope to). NOT a burn-down: no site was fixed and none was
suppressed. The same 53 reads are still counted, under names that describe
what they actually are.
-org-scoped 112 -> 113 is the one RAISED number in this file's history, and it
is a reclassification, not a regression. properties/[id]/setup/checklist/
page.tsx:30 filters through an embedded resource --
.eq('checklist_templates.org_id', ...) -- which the old literal "org_id"
matcher could not see, so a correctly single-tenant read was being counted as
a cross-tenant scan. It moved OUT of -cross-tenant and INTO -org-scoped. The
ladder total is unchanged at 211 across the change, which is the invariant
that matters and is now enforced (mutual exclusion) by the ratchet script.
PROMOTED 2026-08-02: -cross-tenant reached 0 (see above) and moved to
chokepoints.yml, where it gates at --error across the whole tree instead of
only on findings new vs. the PR base. Its key is deleted here in the same
change, per the promotion rule in .semgrep/README.md — a rule cannot be in
both files, and check-semgrep-ratchet.mjs fails on a baseline entry whose
rule ratchet.yml no longer declares.
